_metadata.description: Static and browser gates that make the catalog source itself a tested surface.

requirements.title: Latest and draft catalog TSX is type-checked and linted
requirements.description: The UI package owns a dedicated catalog conformance surface over `library/components/**/versions/**`. The gate derives latest and draft TSX files from component manifests, runs TypeScript and ESLint against those files, and is wired into `make lint-ui` plus the scenario test plan.

validation.notes: `pnpm run catalog:check` and `make lint-ui` passed after the catalog conformance scripts/configs were added. A temporary Button type error produced the expected TypeScript failure before removal.

requirements.title: Full catalog preview sweep runs in a real browser
requirements.description: `ui/scripts/preview-e2e.mjs` enumerates catalog components from the API, opens the real UI in Chromium, switches the editor to preview mode, and validates every preview/example iframe reaches ready without forbidden console, pageerror, host, or in-iframe runtime failures.

validation.notes: `pnpm run test:preview-e2e` passed across all 11 components and curated example frames after Phase 6; focused Button/StatusBadge smoke runs also passed during the runtime resolver fix.

requirements.title: Component experience specs reconcile against harness captures
requirements.description: An `experience-component` document can bind machine-tier component claims to named catalog examples. Experience Manager constructs RCL harness capture targets per example/viewport, drives BAS accessibility capture, applies binding and claim evaluators, and reports component failures advisory until the contract is promoted to gating.

validation.notes: Cross-scenario unit evidence lives in experience-manager: `api/internal/reconcile/reconcile_test.go::TestActiveComponentBuildsHarnessTargetsAndPersistsEvidence` proves component harness target construction and evidence persistence.

Live calibration: `test-genie execute react-component-library experience --json` run 20260710-131340-38f3addd passed clean, temporary ghost claim run 20260710-131446-30feba68 surfaced advisory reconciliation warnings, and post-removal run 20260710-131538-31dc1994 passed clean.
